name: Chen Shuhong
current_role: Director, Red Star Macalline Group; acting-in-concert shareholder with founder Che Jianxing
profile: Chen Shuhong is linked to Red Star Macalline, the Shanghai-based home-furnishing mall operator founded by Che Jianxing. Company filings list her as a board director and as a person acting in concert with Che and Red Star Holdings. Her own business profile is very thin in public sources.
interesting_fact: Red Star Macalline's announcements name Chen Shuhong, together with Che Jianxing, as an acting-in-concert party of controlling shareholder Red Star Holdings, and she sat on the company's fourth board of directors.
notes: An unverified report (ctol.digital) calls her Che Jianxing's wife and says she handled shareholder duties while he was detained; no authoritative source confirmed this. Very private, and the group is in a sensitive period, with shares frozen by courts in 2025. Any approach should go through the company.

name: Prathap Reddy
profile: Cardiologist Prathap C. Reddy (b. 1933) came back to India from the US and in 1983 opened Apollo Hospitals in Chennai, India's first corporate hospital chain. Apollo now runs about 80 hospitals and more than 7,000 pharmacies. His four daughters run the business day to day, and he still speaks publicly as founder-chairman, for example at the International Health Dialogue in January 2026.
interesting_fact: In 2022 Apollo Hospitals Group opened a hospital in Nairobi, Kenya, with Balmer Healthcare, offering 20 specialties. He received the Padma Bhushan (1991) and the Padma Vibhushan (2010).
deep_cut_fact: Before returning to India he did a fellowship at Massachusetts General Hospital and led research programmes at the Missouri State Chest Hospital. In 2012 Apollo opened the first 'Apollo Isha Vidya Rural School' in his home village of Aragonda, in Chittoor district.
notes: He is 93. His daughters (Preetha, Suneeta, Sangita, Shobana) run Apollo day to day, so the best route is Apollo Hospitals' corporate communications. An undated report said he had been hospitalised; treat his availability with care.

name: Catharina Claas-Muhlhauser
current_role: Chair of the Supervisory Board and largest shareholder, CLAAS KGaA mbH; Chair of the Ost-Ausschuss der Deutschen Wirtschaft (since 2023)
profile: Cathrina Claas-Mühlhäuser is the granddaughter of CLAAS founder August Claas and the third generation of the family to lead the Harsewinkel combine and farm-machinery maker, which has almost EUR 5bn in revenue. She succeeded her father Helmut Claas as head of the family's governing bodies. In 2023 she became the first woman to chair the Ost-Ausschuss der Deutschen Wirtschaft, a 70-year-old German business association for Eastern Europe and Central Asia.
interesting_fact: In June 2023 she became the first woman to chair the Ost-Ausschuss der Deutschen Wirtschaft, whose 386 members cover business with Eastern Europe and Central Asia. She called Ukraine's reconstruction a key focus.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining the family business she trained as an industrial business-management assistant, earned an MBA at the University of St. Gallen, and worked for ABB in Switzerland and Chile. Harper Adams University (UK) gave her an honorary doctorate in 2018, and Bulgaria's Agricultural University Plovdiv made her an honorary doctor in 2019.
notes: Spelled Cathrina in most sources. Best route is CLAAS Group Communications in Harsewinkel. Her Ost-Ausschuss role (energy and Ukraine reconstruction) could be a podcast angle. Low personal media profile.
